services.name: C - SAV Haunted Pub Crawl
services.desc: Explore Savannah's historic and haunted bars and pubs on Savannah's #1-rated Pub Crawl. On this 2-hour walking tour of Savannah's most haunted and historic pubs and bars, you'll be entertained as you hear the stories of Savannah's dark past, and our haunted present! You'll be taken on an unforgettable journey into some of Savannah's most haunted and creepy pubs. Along the way you'll be able to purchase and enjoy the great drinks that Savannah has to offer while you walk from one bar to the next and take advantage of Savannah’s open carry liquor laws. services.name: Hilton Head Seafood Festival Daufuskie Island History Experience
services.desc: Step Back in Time on Daufuskie Island Tucked between Hilton Head and the mainland, and accessible only by boat, Daufuskie Island is often described as “the other side of the river” — a hidden gem where time seems to stand still. This small-group excursion offers an intimate journey into the island’s rich history, cultural traditions, and creative spirit. Guided by an experienced interpretive naturalist and USCG-licensed captain, you’ll explore the island’s undeveloped side, visiting remarkable landmarks such as: First Union African Baptist Church – a cornerstone of island faith and community.
